checkpoints.description: [1/1] Immediate-form multiplier, commutative chain folding and direct guest binding of spare copy arguments

impact_assessment.why: Board-wide speed gap: many_params pays a constant register load plus two-operand imul for every homed*literal, chains park their accumulator and round-trip rax, and five-or-six-parameter copies park spare arguments in temporaries only to rebind them at copy entry.
impact_assessment.benefits: Every homed-name-times-constant lowers to one three-operand imul_r,rm,imm; every commutative chain folds into its destination register; spare copy arguments land directly in guest homes with the entry rebinds skipped.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: imul_imm must refuse imm32 overflow and the chain path must refuse shapes whose right side reads or clobbers the destination; dependency: codegen hooks only wrap existing lowering, no new module; concurrency: none, single-threaded compiler; state: benchmark history appends atomically as before.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first byte-level shape tests pin each lowering; full 897-test suite plus ADR-044 leaf-stability pins guard regressions; benchmark gate re-run with noise discharge per ADR-031.

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Magic division seeds and divisors hoist into spare homes

impact_assessment.why: binary_gcd's main loop reloads four 64-bit constants (two seeds, two divisors) per iteration although the hoisting machinery exists and the loop has spare homes.
impact_assessment.benefits: Every looped magic division reads its seed and divisor from hoisted registers; the guest planner stops borrowing hoisted homes, which also closes a latent corruption path for any hoisted loop containing a copy.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: hoist_imm reads must stay guarded to the real body; dependency: only codegen; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first shape test pins the hoisted forms; pair and delta machine frames skip hoisting so r13 rebinds never collide; full suite plus benchmark gate.

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Shift-through fusion: (a>>m)<<k lowers as and -2^k, and single-use copy args of shape name>>m forward into their use

impact_assessment.why: call_chain loses 30 percent to C entirely from the sar+shl chain in the inlined mix3 body (gcc folds (i>>2)<<2 into and -4 via full evaluation); the same shape is the standard floor-to-multiple idiom in real programs and crosses call boundaries in both nqueens and call_chain args
impact_assessment.benefits: call_chain 44.6 -> target near C 34.5 ms; nqueens argument shuffles slim; a general sound peephole in the language
impact_assessment.risks: contract: (a>>m)<<k == a & -(2^k) requires k>=m>=1, verified for signed negatives since sar sign-fill shifts out exactly when k>=m; a forwarded arg must only fire when the parameter occurs exactly once in the copy body and the shift user shape is verifiable at emission; dependency: reuses existing _logical_shift_shape machinery, no new deps; concurrency: none; state: provenance lives only inside one copy emission and must not leak across nested copies
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first bytes tests pinning the and-lowering and absence of sar in the copy region, e2e value tests against a Python wrap model with negative operands and k==m plus k>m, full suite + benchmark gate before commit

checkpoints.description: [1/3] argv builtins: argc() and arg_byte(i, j) over GetCommandLineA; [2/3] stdin read_char() with a 4096-byte buffered static in writable .data; [3/3] dedicated benchmark twins + benchmark gate

impact_assessment.why: the language cannot react to the outside world: no stdin, no args, only print builtins; input is the first step of a usable language per the agreed roadmap
impact_assessment.benefits: programs can consume argv and stdin; string handling becomes reachable; one import and one writable-data extension
impact_assessment.risks: contract: argv[0] is the program path (C convention) and read_char returns -1 on EOF; dependency: GetStdHandle and GetCommandLineA join the import table, and .data gains labels after the IAT; concurrency: none; state: static cursor/count live in .data, zero-initialized by the loader
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first sema/codegen/e2e tests per builtin; buffered reads mean one ReadFile per 4096 bytes; benchmark twin set pins throughput equivalence; keep the existing print ABI untouched
